posts.en:
dsh-packer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d8ace320d13ebc00efba.html
